quarterly_data.quarter: Japan Material annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis (annual securities report): in its industry, with high growth still expected centred on generative AI, semiconductor makers expanded capex on rising demand for advanced semiconductors. In the Electronics segment the Initial department (specialty gas supply equipment development and manufacturing, supply piping design and construction) grew sales and segment profit as capex at its main customers' semiconductor fabs expanded and continued. In the Operation department (specialty gas sales management, technical services), sales fell because unit prices declined in part of specialty gas sales, but segment profit rose on growing operations at a new semiconductor fab started in fiscal 2024 and continued high production at its main customer's NAND flash memory fab.

quarterly_data.quarter: Japan Material annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's strategy (annual securities report): the group's mid- to long-term goal is to contribute behind the scenes to the revival of Japanese semiconductors, taking on semiconductor fabs from start-up (Initial) through operation (Operation); its first challenge is securing skilled engineers, which it is meeting through in-house training as outside hiring is very difficult. It aims to strengthen the stable-revenue Operation department by actively expanding Total Facility Management (TFM) and semiconductor equipment maintenance, winning new customers in existing fields and entering new fields. Its target management indicators are operating margin and consolidated operating income.
